title: Graph comparison agrees with the canonical map into direct image
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f:U\to X$ separated etale, and $c=(j,r)$ a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $a:f_{\Sigma!}\to j_!r_*$ be the graph sheaf comparison [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison], with sum extension as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. For every sheaf $M$ of $A$-modules on $U_{\mathrm{et}}$, the composite of $a_M$ with $r_*(j_!M\to j_*M)$ and the canonical direct-image compositor is precisely etaleLowerShriekToLowerStar$(A,f,M):f_{\Sigma!}M\to f_*M$. No Noetherianity, finiteness of $A$, or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 03S3 (definition-extension-zero), 03S5 (proposition-describe-jshriek), 03S6 (lemma-shriek-base-change), 0F4L (lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale); more-etale.tex Tags 0F50, 0F51 and 0F7B-0F7F; graph-adjunction normalization on unbounded complexes supplied by the agent

proof.text: Apply the injective homEquiv of the etale lower-shriek restriction adjunction. The transpose normalization theorem identifies the left side with lowerStarUnit; the definition of etaleLowerShriekToLowerStar identifies the right side with the inverse image of that same unit under homEquiv.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportGraphSheafComparison_normalization
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X)
    [Etale f] [IsSeparated f] (c : Compactification f)
    (M : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) :
    (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A f c).app M ≫
        (compactificationSheafToDirectImage A c).app M =
      etaleLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f M
